GEMM: General Matrix-Matrix Multiplication

 $$ \boldsymbol{C}=\boldsymbol{A}\times\boldsymbol{B} $$ 

 $$ \begin{array}{r l}{\mathcal{M}}&{\stackrel{\leftarrow}{\longrightarrow}\boxed{\begin{array}{c}{\boldsymbol{K}}\\ {\boldsymbol{A}}\end{array}}}\\ &{\quad\boldsymbol{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{\boldsymbol{M}\times\boldsymbol{K}}}\end{array}\quad\times\quad\begin{array}{c}{\uparrow}\\ {\boldsymbol{K}}\\ {\downarrow}\end{array}\begin{array}{c}{\longleftarrow\boldsymbol{N}}\\ {\boxed{\begin{array}{c}{\boldsymbol{B}}\\ {\boldsymbol{B}\in\mathbb{R}^{\boldsymbol{K}\times\boldsymbol{N}}}\end{array}}}\\ \end{array}=\begin{array}{c}{\boldsymbol{M}}\\ {\longleftarrow\boxed{\begin{array}{c}{\boldsymbol{C}}\\ {\boldsymbol{C}\in\mathbb{R}^{\boldsymbol{M}\times\boldsymbol{N}}}\end{array}}}\\ \end{array}} $$ 

 $$ (\mathbf{M}\times\mathbf{K})\cdot(\mathbf{K}\times\mathbf{N})\to(\mathbf{M}\times\mathbf{N}) $$ 

 $$ \begin{array}{c} C_{ij}~=~\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{K}\cdot\mathbf{A}_{ik}\quad\mathbf{B}_{kj}\end{array} $$ 

Each Cij is the dot product of row i of A and column j of B.

## Parallel GEMM: Row Partitioning Example: 8 rows of A across 4 MPI ranks $$ \mathbf{C}=\mathbf{A}\times\mathbf{B} $$ Dimensions: $A(8\times K)\times B(K\times N)=C(8\times N)\rightarrow$ Each rank computes $a$ ($2\times N$) block.
1 Partition A by rows
2 Every rank uses the full B
3 Compute independently
4 Row blocks form C Assembled in row order Once A is partitioned and B is available, the four local GEMMs can run at the same time.
text:
Parallel GEMM: Row Partitioning
Example: 8 rows of A across 4 MPI ranks
 $$ \mathbf{C}=\mathbf{A}\times\mathbf{B} $$
